principles.meaning: the shape of every domain object is validated, so malformed state cannot exist
principles.name: Structure over trust

principles.meaning: every external dependency is swappable without a code change, so the deployed system is the reviewed system
principles.name: Config over hardcoding

principles.meaning: every state transition is written to an append-only stream, so "what did the agent decide, and why" is always answerable
principles.name: Evidence over assertion

principles.meaning: machines propose, a human confirms anything that leaves a durable mark
principles.name: Humans over automation for consequences

principles.meaning: the agent has a deterministic fallback, and the tests never touch a live model
principles.name: Determinism over hope
